dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards a sharp point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle outward bulge along the right lateral margin near the mid-body; otherwise margins are smooth.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-gray to off-white median intensity; high-reflectance specular highlights along the dorsal ridge and lateral edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One high-contrast, dark circular aperture (blowhole) at the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent raised linear ridge along the central dorsal axis extending towards the posterior, creating a vertical shadow gradient.
